Using atmospheric methods trusted by global science leaders, including the WMO, our platform quantifies carbon flux across soil, vegetation, and atmosphere.

our principles

our principles

What Drives Us Forward.

01

Not All Data is Created Equal

Quantification must be conclusive, traceable, and built for real-world decisions.

02

Science First

Alethia applies the same atmospheric measurement methods trusted by global climate authorities, including the World Meteorological Organization.

03

Transparent by Design

Blockchain-secured infrastructure ensures data is tamper-proof, traceable, and audit-ready for insetting, offsetting, and BVCM claims.

04

Sensor-Based Verification

Sensor towers and Eddy Covariance systems capture real-time GHG exchange, delivering reliable, decision-ready carbon flux data at the ecosystem level.

05

Real-Time Monitoring

Real-time, site-specific carbon flux measurement—continuous, not seasonal—scaled to fields, forests, or farms to convert ecosystem data into actionable insights.
